segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, second page's minetn entry) to the minetn-1 Orcish Town variant selected by seed 7406 from the preselected 7400-7407 scan. It reaches check_ransacked() and stolen_booty(), including migrating named orcs and their loot: do_name.c rndorcname() draws the hyphen before each chunk, and makemon() hands the waiting booty to each gang orc through dokick.c deliver_obj_to_mon() at the crime scene.
